ShortDescription.Value: Co-op multiplayer: build one city together with your friends over Steam. Early test version.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Skyline Together
Co-op multiplayer for Cities: Skylines II. One player hosts their city, friends join and get a copy of it, and from then on everything anyone builds is shared live. The host's game runs the simulation; the other players' games show the host's city and send their actions to the host, which checks and applies them for everyone.
**Early test version.** Hosting, joining and the sync of the city work in test sessions, but it has not been through many long sessions yet. Expect bugs, back up your saves and play on a copy of a city.
## What is shared
- Roads, buildings, zoning, districts, transport lines, terrain and water - Budget, taxes, loans, policies, milestones and unlocks - Traffic, citizens, vehicles and the numbers in the info panels - Game speed (the host's speed is everyone's; builders can change it for all) - Other players' cursors with name tags, their building previews in their colour, and chat
## How to play
**Host:** load a city, click the round Skyline Together button in the top-left corner and press **Host this city**. Send your friends your Steam ID (copy icon at the top of the panel) or use **Invite friends**.
**Join:** on the title screen click **Multiplayer**, then **Join a friend**. Paste the host's Steam ID and the password if there is one, and press **Join**, or accept the host's Steam invite. Your game downloads and loads the host's city; the host's game pauses until you are in. Press **Enter** to chat.
No port forwarding is needed for Steam joins. Direct IP connections are optional and need a forwarded UDP port.
## Requirements and compatibility
- Steam version of the game on Windows, with Steam running. - Every player needs the **same version of Skyline Together** (the panel shows a build id: it must be the same on every PC), the **same game version** and, by default, the **same code mods** in the same versions. If the mods differ, the join screen lists exactly what to enable, disable or update, and the host can let players join anyway. - Mods that only change your own screen (translations, tooltips, icon libraries, overlays) may differ. Traffic, Move It, Anarchy, Better Bulldozer, Tree Controller, Water Features, Plop the Growables, 529 Tiles, Historical Start, Zoning Toolkit, Line Tool and Find It have dedicated support; other code mods are analysed automatically. - Use the same asset subscriptions on every PC. Objects whose asset a player lacks are left out on that player's game. - **Not compatible with other multiplayer mods.** Disable them. - **Install it only once.** Do not keep a copy in the local Mods folder (from the GitHub installer) while you are subscribed here: the game then loads only one of them. Skyline Together warns at start when it finds two copies. - A game update can switch features off until the mod is updated; the startup self-test (Options, Skyline Together) shows which.
## Bugs, documentation and source code
Everything is on GitHub: https://github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether The user guide, the FAQ and troubleshooting are in the docs folder there. For a bug report, click **Write diagnostics** in the panel and attach the diagnostics file and the log (Logs/SkylineTogether.log in the game's user data folder) of every player to a GitHub issue.

Publish.ChangeLog:
First version on Paradox Mods, an early test build: expect bugs and play on a copy of a city.
- Host a loaded city; join by Steam ID, Steam invite or direct IP; optional password; 2 to 16 players - The host's city is saved, streamed to the joining player and loaded; the host pauses while someone joins - Host-authoritative sync of structures, economy, terrain, water, traffic, citizens and vehicles; every player builds with the normal tools - Roles, kick and ban, cursors with name tags, building previews, chat, shared game speed - Automatic integrity checks and repair, resync and reconnect - Mod compatibility checks with a readable list of what to change; support for 12 popular mods - Solo test: record a session and replay it through the joining player's code path
Full changelog: https://github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
